purpose: DOI Handle System verification of every DOI cited in protocol_explosive-regime-review_2026-08-24.md, executed at protocol-drafting time. This is citation verification, not an evidence search: no records were screened or carried into any corpus.
method: GET https://doi.org/api/handles/{doi}; responseCode 1 = resolves. Publisher-page 403s to automated probes are the known G16 false-positive class and are not tested here.
executed_by: Claude Fable 5 (model id claude-fable-5), research-librarian agent, Claude Code / Claude Agent SDK
known_item_crossref_resolution: Known-item DOIs were resolved via api.crossref.org query.bibliographic / query.title lookups on 2026-08-24 before handle verification; raw responses not retained (metadata lookups, not discovery queries). Evans (1991), 'Pitfalls in Testing for Explosive Bubbles in Asset Prices', American Economic Review 81(4), returned NO Crossref DOI under two queries (query.title variants); the pre-1997 AER back-catalog is not DOI-registered. Carried in the protocol known-item list as a FAIR F1 gap with identifier resolution deferred to search execution.
